author: Cinna Davis with OpenAI Codex assistance
statement: Every ordering of a binary matrix with kernel dimension k and minimum kernel weight D>=2 has frontier width at least k/ceil(m/(D-1)) and all-cut width sum at least k(D-1); accepted sparse-check distance and row counts give a conditional application. No SAT bound is changed.
remaining_obligations: Independent review of the all-size proof and application
Determine actual nullity and frontier width for relevant sparse-check matrices
Develop a complete representation and full SAT cost accounting; no speedup is claimed
